subproblem.title: The class 𝓜 is closed under the rescalings μ ↦ ofReal(λ⁻¹ⁿ)•μ.map(dilation y λ), 0 < λ < 1, ‖y‖ ≤ 1 − λ (property (3); conditional on blowup_calculus and blowup_imrep)
subproblem.statement: Assume (BC) — the frozen type of the selected node's registered dependency blowup_calculus: for all P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), x ∈ ℝ^P and λ > 0: (i) M_W(blowUp T x λ) = ofReal(λ⁻¹ⁿ)·M_{(dilation x λ)⁻¹(W)}(T) for every W; (ii) currentEval (blowUp T x λ) ω = currentEval T (affinePullbackForm (dilationCLM P λ) (−(λ⁻¹•x)) ω) for every n-form ω on ℝ^P; (iii) currentEval (blowUp (blowUp T x λ) y μ) ω = currentEval (blowUp T (x + λ•y) (λμ)) ω for all y ∈ ℝ^P, μ > 0 and n-forms ω. Assume also (BUI) — the frozen type of the selected node's registered dependency blowup_imrep (the reused accepted rep_pushforward): for all P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), x ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0 and every IMRep R of T in U there is an IMRep R′ in dilation x λ '' U representing blowUp T x λ with R′.measure(s) = ofReal(λ⁻¹ⁿ)·R.measure((dilation x λ)⁻¹(s)) for every Borel s. Let n, k, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≤ k and 1 ≤ n, let U ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} be open, N an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-dimensional submanifold with (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) minimizing in U ∩ N with spt T ⊆ U ∩ N and ∂T = 0 in U. Let z ∈ ℝ^{n+k} and r > 0 with B̄_{2r}(z) ⊆ U, and let RT be an IMRep of T in U; write μ_T := RT.measure, W := B_{2r}(z) and η_{a,t} := dilation a t (η_{a,t}(v) = t⁻¹(v − a)). Let 𝓜 be a set of measures on ℝ^{n+k} such that μ ∈ 𝓜 if and only if either (PS) μ = ofReal(t⁻¹ⁿ) • (μ_T⌞W).map η_{a,t} for some a ∈ ℝ^{n+k} and some t with 0 < t ≤ r and dist(a, z) ≤ r − t; or (ZS) μ = RS.measure for some S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+k}) and some IMRep RS of S in ℝ^{n+k} for which there are points c_i, scales t_i > 0 (i ∈ ℕ) and a point b with dist(c_i, z) < r − t_i for every i, t_i → 0, c_i → b, and blowUp T c_i t_i ⇀ S in ℝ^{n+k} (ConvergesWeakly). (These are the selected node's positive-scale members μ_{x,λ} and zero-scale members, with (a, t) = (z + rx, rλ), c_i = z + rx_i, t_i = rλ_i, b = z + rx̄.) Then for every μ ∈ 𝓜, every y ∈ ℝ^{n+k} and every λ with 0 < λ < 1 and ‖y‖ ≤ 1 − λ, the measure ofReal(λ⁻¹ⁿ) • μ.map (dilation y λ) belongs to 𝓜.

t ∧ μ = ENNReal.ofReal (t⁻¹ ^ n) • (RT.measure.restrict (ball z (2 * r))).map (dilation a t)) ∨ ∃ (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + k))) n) (RS : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid (n + k))) n) (cs : ℕ → Euclid (n + k)) (ts : ℕ → ℝ) (hts : ∀ i, 0 < ts i) (b : Euclid (n + k)), (∀ i, dist (cs i) z < r - lam → ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) • μ.map (dilation y lam) ∈ 𝓜)
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 5 of the selected node's supplied proof (parent 2(c); Simon 7.3.3, proof of (1), (10), chapter-07.txt line 472: η_{x,λ#}𝒯 ⊆ 𝒯 for 0 < λ < 1, |x| < 1 − λ), in the parametrization (a, t) = (z + rx, rλ) of positive-scale members and (c_i, t_i, b) = (z + rx_i, rλ_i, z + rx̄) of zero-scale data. Siblings used: ambient_calculus (Submission.idtp_fons_cc_ambient_calculus) part (7), and zero_limit_rescale (Submission.dimred_tr_bc_zero_limit_rescale), applied with (BC) and (BUI).
Let μ ∈ 𝓜, y ∈ ℝ^{n+k}, 0 < λ < 1 and ‖y‖ ≤ 1 − λ, and put μ′ := ofReal(λ⁻¹ⁿ) • μ.map(dilation y λ). By the class hypothesis, μ is (PS) or (ZS).
1. (Triangle inequality.) For s ≥ 0 and c ∈ ℝ^{n+k}: dist(c + s•y, z) = ‖(c − z) + s•y‖ ≤ dist(c, z) + ‖s•y‖ = dist(c, z) + s‖y‖ ≤ dist(c, z) + s(1 − λ).
2. (Case PS.) μ = ofReal(t⁻¹ⁿ) • (μ_T⌞W).map(dilation a t) with 0 < t ≤ r and dist(a, z) ≤ r − t. ambient_calculus (7), with ν := μ_T⌞W, s := t and t := λ, gives μ′ = ofReal((tλ)⁻¹ⁿ) • (μ_T⌞W).map(dilation (a + t•y) (tλ)). The pair (a + t•y, tλ) is admissible: tλ > 0; tλ ≤ t ≤ r because λ < 1; and dist(a + t•y, z) ≤ (r − t) + t(1 − λ) = r − tλ by step 1. So μ′ is (PS), and μ′ ∈ 𝓜 by the class hypothesis.
3. (Case ZS.) μ = RS.measure, where RS is an IMRep of S in ℝ^{n+k} and (c_i, t_i, b) are zero-scale data for S (with positivity proofs hts). Apply zero_limit_rescale with (BC), (BUI), P := n + k, U, T, cs := (c_i), ts := (t_i), hts, S, y, λ and the convergence blowUp T c_i t_i ⇀ S. It gives S′ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+k}) with blowUp T (c_i + t_i•y) (t_iλ) ⇀ S′ and, for RS, an IMRep RS′ of S′ in ℝ^{n+k} with RS′.measure = μ′.
4. The data c′_i := c_i + t_i•y, t′_i := t_iλ (positivity proofs mul_pos (hts i) hλ) and b′ := b are zero-scale data for S′:
 (a) dist(c′_i, z) ≤ dist(c_i, z) + t_i(1 − λ) < (r − t_i) + t_i(1 − λ) = r − t′_i (step 1);
 (b) t_iλ → 0·λ = 0 (Tendsto.mul_const);
 (c) c_i + t_i•y → b + 0•y = b (Tendsto.add, Tendsto.smul_const);
 (d) blowUp T c′_i t′_i ⇀ S′ is the convergence of step 3 (the same currents).
 Since RS′ represents S′ and μ′ = RS′.measure, μ′ is (ZS), so μ′ ∈ 𝓜. ∎
proof_key_steps: Positive scale: ambient_calculus (7) gives (μ_T⌞W)^{a,t} rescaled by (y, λ) = (μ_T⌞W)^{a+ty,tλ}, and (a + ty, tλ) is admissible by the triangle inequality.
Zero scale: zero_limit_rescale turns blowUp T c_i t_i ⇀ S into blowUp T (c_i + t_i y)(t_i λ) ⇀ S′, with an IMRep of S′ whose weight is the rescaled weight.
The new data satisfy dist(c_i + t_i y, z) < r − t_iλ, t_iλ → 0 and c_i + t_i y → b, so the rescaled measure is a zero-scale member.

audit.reason: Affine composition and the triangle inequality preserve positive-scale admissibility and strict zero-scale admissibility. zero_limit_rescale supplies the transformed current and weight. Dependencies are sufficient and correctly directed.
